entries.wording: Su envio esta en viaje a sucursal
entries.note: The parcel is on its way to the delivering branch.

entries.wording: Su envio llego a la sucursal de destino
entries.note: The parcel reached the delivering branch.
The branch loaded the parcel for its round; the delivery or a missed attempt follows the same day.

entries.wording: No encontramos a nadie en el domicilio
entries.note: Nobody was home; another round follows.
The recipient did not answer at the door.

entries.wording: El chofer informo la entrega de su envio
entries.note: The driver reported the delivery; Su envio fue entregado follows in the same minute.

entries.wording: El envió será devuelto al remitente por devolución al cliente
entries.note: The parcel will go back to the sender; the wording ends with the reason, so the code sets the stage.

entries.wording: Devolucion en viaje a la casa central
entries.note: The returned parcel is on its way to Urbano's head office.
The returned parcel was handed to the head office.

entries.wording: Conformes y devoluciones rendidos al remitente
entries.note: Returned parcels and delivery receipts were handed back to the sender.
